question:
Following successful surgical repair of a displaced talar neck fracture in a 21-year-old man, which
complication is most likely to develop in the long term, despite achieving anatomic reduction and stable
fixation? Answer Choices: (A) Progressive ankle instability (B) Chronic synovitis (C) Post-traumatic
flatfoot deformity (D) Nonunion (E) Osteonecrosis (F) Malunion with varus deformity (G) Nonunion of
the talar neck (H) Tarsal tunnel syndrome (I) Tibiotalar and/or subtalar arthritis (J) Chronic regional pain
syndrome

A. Nonunion of the talar neck
B. Post-traumatic flatfoot deformity
C. Nonunion
D. Chronic regional pain syndrome
E. Tarsal tunnel syndrome
F. Progressive ankle instability
G. Tibiotalar and/or subtalar arthritis
H. Malunion with varus deformity
I. Chronic synovitis
J. Osteonecrosis
